title: Equal-mode opposite charges cancel angular harmonic-holonomy work

angular_cancellation.species_identity: For charge q in {+e,-e}, H_q=(1/2)sum_k[|dot phi_(q,k)|^2+(m^2+|k-q a|^2)|phi_(q,k)|^2] obeys H_q'=-q dot(a) dot sum_k(k-q a)|phi_(q,k)|^2.
angular_cancellation.pairing_condition: Assume equal same-k amplitudes |phi_(+,k)|^2=|phi_(-,k)|^2=w_k on the interval considered.
angular_cancellation.exact_sum: The momentum-linear terms cancel and H_+'+H_-'=2e^2 dot(a) dot a sum_k w_k=e^2 d(|a|^2)/dt sum_k w_k.
angular_cancellation.angular_consequence: If |a| is constant, the paired adapted energy is exactly conserved even when int|dot a| diverges. Angular holonomy variation is cost-free; only radial amplitude variation remains in this identity.
angular_cancellation.invariant_control: The same-mode condition need not be invariant for general nonzero Fourier data. The homogeneous k=0 equal-species sector is invariant and includes K1589's exact orbit.
angular_cancellation.scope_guard: Gauss neutrality alone does not imply the pairing condition. No unequal-mode, oscillatory-field, radial-remainder or global-flow cancellation is proved.
